text: Adopt the objectors' condition. in_zone:ma_20 buys the pullback itself, which C5 forbids; a tie-break from one seat does not change that. WWW is AT its high: dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.46, W and D HH/HL. The entry is the new high: h1_close_above:bar_high. Extension (close_vs_swing_high_pct 8.52) is late-leg risk (C15), answered by the danger signal, one atr_14d off the day's high (my translation, C7), not by waiting for a reaction. I add no day_vol line of my own (fill difficulty NOT_SERVED, R5). Clears for me: the trigger becomes h1_close_above:bar_high.
